{{Quote|Kippy Martin was a former security officer at Stonewall Labs, but she had to quit after falling off of a speeder while moving at close to top speed. Kippy didn't seem to be badly hurt, but was never the same again.|[[Vance Groten]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FaSB" />}}
'''Kippy Martin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Do you have a security beacon from Stonewall Labs?''"<br />"''Yes. Yes I do. Well, no actually I don't. I buried it. I was hoping it would grow into a beacon tree. So far, nothing, but I haven't given up hope. It's only been a few years. I still think it'll sprout into something.|A spacer and Kippy Martin|<ref name="SWG:FaSB" />}}
Kippy Martin took up residence on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Naboo. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she worked as a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] at [[Stonewall Labs]], along with [[Walker Luskeske]], under the orders of the [[Chief of Security|Security Chief]] [[Vance Groten]]. However, she had to quit after falling off a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] while reaching close to top speed. Kippy was not badly hurt, but she was never the same since the accident.<ref name="SWG:FaSB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Kippy Martin stayed at a camp in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] near [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]]. While there, she was pestered by a swarm of starving [[flewt]]s. A spacer who was looking for a [[security beacon]] from Stonewall Labs accepted to kill the creatures to help her.<ref name="SWG:FaSB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kippy Martin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FaSB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kippy Martin was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
